cc:Work.dc:title: 279 large ships reach Vancouver, 174 km from the entrance: 48% of the 580 seen at the entrance
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the Columbia River route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 580 ships at the entrance and 279 at Vancouver.
